description: The poisoned lake in the forest during the Pandavas' exile. Yudhishthira faces the Yaksha (Dharma in disguise) who poses riddles. His brothers lie dead around the lake shore. Vana Parva.

vn_backdrop_notes.lighting: Twilight. Eerie mist over the water.
interactive_elements: The Yaksha's voice from the lake
Four fallen brothers (Bhima, Arjuna, Nakula, Sahadeva)
vn_backdrop_notes.note: The Yaksha Prashna — one of the epic's most famous dialogues.
